summary: Permit one earlier signed retry for a recently successful plain HTTP peer

replay.detail: Envelope receipt, duplicate handling, projection and replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: No durable table, index or data-format changes; retry credit is private task-local state.

rules.detail: No claim or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: A qualifying peer may receive one additional off-cadence signed exchange after a typed before-header plain HTTP transport failure and a successful HEAD. This does not change authentication, member refusal, signed overload or Fabric grant checks. HTTPS and unclassified failures use the existing retry path.

downtime.detail: No migration or additional service interruption beyond a normal binary swap.

manual.detail: No new configuration or manual action.

recovery.detail: The opportunity starts absent, expires within five monotonic minutes of a complete successful signed exchange, and is spent before export. A failed advance resumes the original capped absolute retry deadline and ordinary backoff count; a new signed overload cooldown may extend that deadline. Restart discards credit. Authentication, membership and route changes refuse further advanced submissions. This source draft does not certify ten-second recovery or remove quarantine.
